name: pyhouse-flat
description: Flat package-by-technical-role Python service skills for workers, crawlers, pipelines, ETL and glue, written for one service on its own and equally true of a workspace member: the layered package layout and what each package may import, the one package that owns a service's data access and the obligations that come with it, entrypoint trigger choice between loop, schedule, stream and durable execution, the multi-service repository when there is more than one service, and the four test families that cover them. Depends on pyhouse-universal, which Claude Code installs with it.
